# Longwave

> Longwave is a hosted video pipeline for AI agents. It turns a creator's long-form episodes into
> YouTube Shorts, generates the thumbnails and metadata, syndicates the audio as a podcast feed, and
> publishes to the creator's own YouTube channel through a verified upload grant. Agents connect over
> MCP with OAuth 2.1. There is no API key, and the agent never downloads video, holds Google
> credentials, or drives YouTube Studio.

Longwave is a product of Signal Group Limited (New Zealand). The company is not a party to any
third-party platform's terms and never contacts those platforms; it produces files and publishes
through official APIs.

## Connect

- [MCP endpoint](https://www.longwave.media/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP, stateless. Call it with no
  credential and it answers `401` with a `WWW-Authenticate` challenge.
- [Protected-resource metadata](https://www.longwave.media/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource):
  RFC 9728 discovery document.
- [Authorization server metadata](https://www.longwave.media/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server):
  RFC 8414. Supports authorization code + PKCE S256 and rotating refresh tokens, with RFC 7591
  dynamic client registration.
- [Plugin repository](https://github.com/Longwave-Media/longwave-plugin): the distribution
  package. Install with `grok plugin install Longwave-Media/longwave-plugin`.

## Tools

Fifteen tools in three grant tiers. A fresh connection receives read access and the ability to create
jobs; publishing to a live channel and changing a published thumbnail are separate approvals.

- Create and inspect: `account_status`, `create_shorts_job`, `get_job`, `list_clips`,
  `create_supercut`
- Read: `list_episodes`, `get_episode`, `get_insights`, `get_content_intelligence`,
  `get_channel_overview`, `list_playlists`, `list_thumbnail_styles`
- Change something public: `publish_shorts`, `reschedule_post`, `approve_thumbnail`

`tools/list` is authoritative and returns each tool's full JSON Schema.

## Cost

Credits are charged per Short that actually publishes. A failed render costs nothing. New accounts
receive 200 free credits that do not expire. An agent can never spend money — it holds no card, and a
low balance returns a top-up link for the creator.

- [Pricing](https://www.longwave.media/pricing)
